issues.desc: index.json description and background.md both use the abbreviation/label "L0" (e.g. "the read-only milestone_closeout command is registered in process-fact-levels.ts (L0 readiness-read)") without expanding what the L0 level classification means anywhere in the story text. A standalone reader with no prior process-fact-levels.ts context cannot infer what L0 signifies from the text alone (verified process-fact-levels.ts:141 does use level: "L0" but the story text never defines the level scale). Not blocking: it does not affect understanding of what the two checklist items require.

Checklist items lack explicit userSees fields. CHK-002 context adequately describes the observable pass/fail contract-test behavior, but adding a userSees with the exact expected test output line would strengthen traceability for future reviewers.
